text: On June 18, 2019, a request was by City Council made through item MM8.32, to explore the feasibility of renaming Wilson Heights Parkette, located at 576 Wilson Heights Boulevard, to Michael Feldman Parkette. Property naming and renaming are a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division has reviewed the Council-approved City of Toronto Property Naming Policy and found that this naming proposal meets the policy criteria and process. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division recommends that Wilson Heights Parkette, located at 576 Wilson Heights Boulevard, be renamed to Michael Feldman Parkette.
The North York Community Council: 1. Renamed Wilson Heights Parkette, located at 576 Wilson Heights Boulevard, to Michael Feldman Parkette.
